page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c28g1.7xlarge is a GPU-accelerated server instance powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor. It features 28 dedicated physical cores on the x86_64 architecture running at 2.5 GHz, paired with 112 GB of system memory. The hardware configuration includes a bundled 472 GB local SSD and a single NVIDIA P100 GPU from the Pascal family with 16 GB of VRAM. Network connectivity is supported by a 5 Gbps baseline bandwidth.

Benchmark data reveals distinct performance tradeoffs. Single-core CPU performance is positioned in the bottom 10% for stress-ng, and single-threaded compression tasks like gzip and bzip3 fall into the bottom 25%. However, multi-core CPU performance, multi-threaded bzip3 decompression, and Passmark CPU scores align with the middle 50% average. Notably, the server excels in LLM inference tasks, achieving top-tier performance in the top 10% for prompt processing on both small and medium models, as well as text generation on the medium model.

From a qualitative cost efficiency perspective, the inclusion of dedicated physical cores, local SSD storage, and a dedicated GPU provides a balanced resource density for parallel computing workloads without requiring separate storage attachments. The instance is suited for workloads such as medium-scale LLM inference, multi-threaded data processing, and GPU-accelerated database operations, though it is less optimal for single-threaded compute-bound tasks.
